issue_title: Bug: Ledger.commit_batch() leaves entries half-applied when one transfer fails (no rollback)
issue_body:
## Bug Report
**File:** `src/ledger.py`

`commit_batch()` applies transfers one at a time; if a later transfer fails (e.g. insufficient funds) earlier ones stay applied. The batch must be atomic: either all transfers apply or none.
### Expected
- any failing transfer rolls back the whole batch and re-raises ValueError
- `balance()` reflects only fully-applied batches
buggy_behaviors: failed batch leaves earlier transfers applied
